questions.text: Where is Arlan Bekov from?
questions.hint: "I am 19 years old and I am from Astana, the capital of Kazakhstan."

questions.text: Arlan can cook well — he learned from his mother.
questions.hint: "I cannot cook at all — I always burn the food or forget to add salt."

questions.text: What age was Arlan when he became the city chess champion?
questions.hint: "I was the Under-18 city champion in Astana when I was 16 years old."

questions.text: Malika can draw and paint. Three of her ___ are displayed in the WKU Art Gallery.
questions.hint: "Three of them are displayed in the WKU Art Gallery!"

questions.text: Which of these can Malika do?
questions.hint: "I can sing... I can also dance — I know traditional Kazakh dances and modern hip-hop."

questions.text: Malika can speak English very fluently.
questions.hint: "My English is not very strong yet — I can understand a lot, but I cannot speak very fluently."

questions.text: How many languages can Ainur speak?
questions.hint: "Ainur from Astana can speak five languages: Kazakh, Russian, English, Chinese, and Korean!"

questions.text: What do Arlan and Malika agree to teach each other?
opts: Arlan teaches coding, Malika teaches drawing
Arlan teaches chess, Malika teaches cooking
Arlan teaches languages, Malika teaches singing
Arlan teaches maths, Malika teaches dancing
questions.correct: Arlan teaches chess, Malika teaches cooking
questions.hint: "Arlan will teach Malika chess, and Malika will teach Arlan how to cook a proper meal."

questions.text: What does Arlan need help with in "Can you help me?"
opts: The design of his CS presentation slides
questions.correct: The design of his CS presentation slides
questions.hint: "I need to design the slides for my CS presentation. But I can't draw at all!"

questions.text: Malika can use Canva to create designs.
questions.hint: "I can also use Canva — can you?" — Malika.

questions.text: What does Malika ask Arlan to help her with?
questions.hint: "Can you help me too? I can't understand my Economics maths homework." — Malika.

questions.text: Bekzat tried to play ___ once but said it was terrible.
questions.hint: "I tried guitar once — terrible!" — Bekzat in "Talents and skills".

questions.text: Ainur can dance very well.
questions.hint: "I can't dance. I have two left feet!" — Ainur.

questions.text: What do Bekzat and Ainur decide to do at the end of their conversation?
questions.hint: "We should join the dance club — then we CAN dance by the end of the year." — Ainur.

questions.text: Ainur ___ speak five languages fluently.
questions.hint: CAN never changes for any subject — no -s, no "to". "Ainur can speak."

questions.text: "Bekzat cans play football brilliantly" is correct English.
questions.hint: CAN never gets -s! "Bekzat can play football brilliantly." — always "can", never "cans".

questions.text: ___ Malika sing? — Yes, she can!
questions.hint: Questions with can: Can + subject + base verb? → "Can Malika sing?"

questions.text: Which sentence is 100% correct?
opts: Arlan can to code in Python.
questions.hint: can't + base form ✅. Others: no 'to', no -s, no -ing after can/can't.

questions.text: Arlan doesn't have a driving licence. He ___ drive.
questions.hint: can't + base form. All subjects use can't — no exceptions.

questions.text: "Can she to dance?" is correct English.
questions.hint: No "to" after can in questions! "Can she dance?" — base form directly.

questions.text: When Bekzat was younger, he ___ run even faster than now.
questions.hint: Past ability → could. "When I was younger, I could run faster."

questions.text: "Can Arlan speak Kazakh?" — Choose the correct short answer.
questions.hint: Short answer: Yes, + subject + can. Never repeat the verb. "Yes, he can."

questions.text: What does "talent" mean?
opts: a skill learned through years of hard training
a natural ability to do something well without being taught
questions.correct: a natural ability to do something well without being taught
questions.hint: Talent = талант — something you are naturally good at, not learned. "Malika has a real talent for singing."

questions.text: Malika won second place at a regional singing ___.
questions.hint: Competition = соревнование — an event where people try to win by being the best.

questions.text: What does "brilliant" describe?
opts: someone who is shy and quiet
questions.hint: "Brilliant" = блестящий. "Bekzat can play football brilliantly — 30 goals last season!"

questions.text: A "beginner" is someone who is already an expert at something.
questions.hint: Beginner = начинающий — someone who is just starting to learn. The opposite of expert.

questions.text: What does "encourage" mean?
opts: to give someone confidence or support to do something
to teach someone a new skill
questions.correct: to give someone confidence or support to do something
questions.hint: "Together we can do anything!" — Malika encourages Arlan.

questions.text: Arlan was the city ___ in chess in Astana when he was 16.
questions.hint: Champion = чемпион — the winner of a competition. "Arlan was the city champion."

questions.text: What does "unique" mean?
opts: being the only one of its kind; unlike anything else
questions.correct: being the only one of its kind; unlike anything else
questions.hint: "Every WKU student has a unique mix of skills and talents." — unique = уникальный.

questions.text: What does "develop" mean?
opts: to forget a skill over time
to grow or cause something to grow stronger over time
questions.correct: to grow or cause something to grow stronger over time
questions.hint: "I am excited to develop new skills at WKU this year." — develop = развивать.
